description: Vector search inside Postgres: the pragmatic RAG database.. This database covers pgvector Engine with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. definition: pgvector Engine — Vector search inside Postgres: the pragmatic RAG database.
key_points: Every database engine makes the same fundamental tradeoffs between read speed, write speed, and space amplification.
The storage engine determines the ceiling; the SQL layer determines the ergonomics.
